info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Education Enrollments Certificates-v5-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Certificates Retrieval API allows users to access and retrieve detailed information about educational enrollment certificates. This endpoint is crucial for institutions and organizations needing to verify and review certificates associated with student enrollments. Typical consumers include administrative staff, educators, and compliance teams who require certification data for reporting or validation purposes. By facilitating easy access to certificate data, this API enhances transparency and supports data-driven decision-making in educational contexts.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the certificate related to a specific enrollment. It provides the necessary information to verify the enrollment status and details for a student. Use this endpoint to access official documentation regarding enrollment certificates.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the certificate of an enrollment. Ensure that you provide the necessary data structure as defined in the schema to successfully retrieve the information.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested certificate data.
